{{Top|leg}}
A '''fence-field''' was a type of [[Force field/Legends|force field]], similar to a [[Shock field/Legends|shock field]], used for security purposes around a building or ground installation. The [[Teguta Lusat Port Authority]] employed a fence-field around the perimeter of their [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Rafa IV]].
